about: Tools a client might use, with prices from each vendor's own pricing page on the date checked. The client pays for these on their own account. Recheck the page before you send a setup sheet: plans change.

quo.name: Quo (formerly OpenPhone)
quo.price: Starter $19 per user a month, or $15 paid yearly; Business $33 ($23 yearly)
quo.extra: Texting registration $19.50 one-time, plus $1.50 to $3 a month carrier fee
quo.textback: Missed-call auto-replies are on every plan.

jobber_ai.name: Jobber AI Receptionist
jobber_ai.role: Answers calls and texts 24/7 and books jobs inside Jobber
jobber_ai.price: $29 a month add-on to a Jobber plan
jobber_ai.extra: Needs a Jobber plan: Core $49 a month ($29 yearly), Connect $139 ($99), Grow $199 ($149)
jobber_ai.textback: Answers over call or text and can book jobs.

hcp_csr.name: Housecall Pro CSR AI
hcp_csr.role: AI call answering inside Housecall Pro
hcp_csr.price: No public price; ask Housecall Pro
hcp_csr.extra: Housecall Pro plans: Basic $79 a month ($59 yearly), Essentials $189 ($149), Max $329 ($299)
hcp_csr.textback: Ask Housecall Pro which plan includes it.

rosie.name: Rosie
rosie.price: $49 a month for 250 minutes; $149 for 1,000; $299 for 2,000; 7-day trial
rosie.extra: Website texting add-on $50 a month for 25 conversations

goodcall.name: Goodcall
goodcall.price: Starter $79 a month (100 unique customers), Growth $129, Scale $299

smith_ai.name: Smith.ai AI Receptionist
smith_ai.role: AI answering with a path to live people
smith_ai.price: Free for 25 calls; Pro from $150 a month for 75 calls

smith_live.name: Smith.ai live receptionists
smith_live.price: $300 a month for 30 calls; $810 for 90; $2,100 for 300; no setup fee

ruby.name: Ruby
ruby.price: $250 a month for 50 minutes; $395 for 100; $720 for 200

calendly.name: Calendly
calendly.price: Free plan with one event type; Standard $10 per seat a month

gcal.name: Google Calendar appointment schedule
gcal.price: Free on a personal Google account; premium features need Workspace or Google One
gcal.extra: Set it up on a computer

ten_dlc.line: Business texting from a regular number must be registered with the carriers (A2P 10DLC) under the client's business.
ten_dlc.fees: Through Twilio: sole proprietor or low-volume brand $4 one-time, plus $15 campaign vetting, plus $1.50 to $10 a month per campaign ($2 for sole proprietor). Through Quo: $19.50 one-time plus $1.50 to $3 a month.
ten_dlc.timing: Campaign approval usually takes under a week.

jobber.label: They use Jobber
jobber.booking: Jobber online booking (their Client Hub link)
jobber.why: Turn on the answering and texting add-on in the tool they already pay for.

housecallpro.label: They use Housecall Pro
housecallpro.why: Ask Housecall Pro to switch on CSR AI in the tool they already pay for.

none.label: No field software
none.booking: Calendly free plan or a Google Calendar appointment schedule
none.why: A business number with a missed-call auto-reply is the smallest setup that works.
